content: Hi! How can I help you? Are you looking for the retreat photos or the new highlight video?
Hey! I'd love the photos, and I actually have a few group shots to add. Where should I upload them?
Wonderful! The shared folder is ready, just click the link I sent earlier, and you'll see an 'Upload' button at the top. Your group shots would be a perfect addition!
Got it, uploading now. Did you organize by day or activity?
Yes, I sorted the album by day, plus, I added little captions to the activity sections. Feel free to browse around and let me know if anything seems out of place.
The captions make it easy! I noticed there's a ZIP file too, what's in that?
That ZIP has all the high-res originals, so you can download them for offline viewing or printing. Just click the file and choose 'Download.'
Perfect! I'll grab that. Is the highlight video ready?
It's almost finished exporting! Once it's ready, I'll pop it into the same folder. You can watch it in the browser or download for better quality.
Thanks! I'll check back in a bit. Can I share the album link with the volunteers?
Absolutely, please do! Just remind everyone to only share photos they're comfortable with, and let me know if you want any privacy tweaks.
Will do! Thanks for making this so easy and organized.
You're so welcome! Let me know if you need help with downloads or if you want to add any extra notes or tags to the album.
